speclog.subject: Restrict URL templates to only level one substitutions. - For #259 this significantly reduces the complexity of expansion implementation needed by clients. - Note that percent encoding must only produce upper case letters. - Add a note that implementations should consider a simple custom implementation of expansion over reusing a general purpose one.

URL strings are used in the patch map and entries until they are parsed into a URL record just prior to passing to fetch.
